resandpay_blog_title: Designing an App-in-App Architecture: RetEX on ResandPay's Restaurant Service Integration
resandpay_blog_desc: How to scale an existing multi-service app without breaking core code by adopting the 'App-in-App' (Dual-Core) architectural paradigm and strict cart management[cite: 73, 74].
resandpay_ctx: In Cameroon's urban food service industry, long customer wait times at peak hours lead to customer churn and revenue loss[cite: 73, 74]. The mission at KMSS SARL was to enrich the ResandPay app with a hybrid dining business model[cite: 73, 74].
resandpay_arch: Built on an isolated 'App-in-App' (Dual-Core) paradigm, separating the restaurant universe while sharing core infrastructure[cite: 73, 74, 100]. The stack uses React Native (TypeScript) with Expo, Redux Store for cart persistence[cite: 73, 74], a Laravel REST API, and real-time Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)[cite: 73, 74].
resandpay_chal:
• Strict single-establishment cart rule: Prevention of mixing items from different vendors via Redux logic[cite: 78, 91].
• Flexible fulfillment modes: Click & Collect, Dine-In (with mandatory table number input), and Delivery[cite: 73, 74].
• Cancellation lock: Disabling user cancellation once orders shift to PREPARING[cite: 107].
resandpay_res: Successful integration of 25 pilot restaurants[cite: 121], drastic reduction in wait times[cite: 128], seamless mobile-to-backend communication, and secure transactions via the ResandPay Wallet[cite: 73, 74].
mamacare_blog_title: MamaCare: From Design to Production of a Maternal and Child Health Mobile App
mamacare_blog_desc: Comprehensive retrospective on our Software Engineering BSc thesis project: a unified, secure ecosystem for pregnancy and early childhood tracking[cite: 1, 5, 11].
mamacare_ctx: Maternal and child health is a major public health challenge in Cameroon, characterized by concerning mortality rates and limited access to reliable medical information[cite: 10, 13]. MamaCare provides a trusted digital companion centralizing pregnancy tracking, child health, appointments, and a community space[cite: 5, 11].
mamacare_arch: A three-tier architecture featuring a React Native / Expo 54.0 mobile frontend with TypeScript[cite: 23, 25], a robust Laravel 11 / PHP 8.3 REST API backend[cite: 26], and a document-oriented MongoDB Atlas cloud database[cite: 21, 23, 26].
mamacare_chal:
• Secure hybrid authentication: Pairing Firebase Auth with a custom JWT token validation middleware in Laravel[cite: 13, 30].
• Algorithmic automation: Dynamic calculation of pregnancy weeks, estimated due dates (EDD), and automated status updates for PEV vaccination schedules[cite: 36, 46].
• Production resilience: Fixing Render timeouts, managing Axios interceptors, and integrating SHA fingerprints for Firebase release[cite: 46, 47].
mamacare_res: Fully functional Android APK distributed[cite: 5], validated through rigorous user testing with healthcare professionals and young mothers[cite: 45], paving the way for telemedicine and electronic health record integration[cite: 60].
